OWNER CODE RED, 2026-08-31. This is the single accountable product vertical.

Terminal outcome: one deterministic command consumes a user-local Sherlock two-part movie edition plus one admitted recall export and emits a machine-readable alignment bundle and a locally inspectable static report. The bundle binds exact movie bytes by digest without storing or redistributing video, declares the edition playback axis, retains source and recall evidence, builds the existing typed narrative and recall graphs, runs partial unbalanced GraphHsmm inference, preserves full posterior P, transition flow F, named external states and Viterbi as a summary, and lets a researcher trace one recall unit to exact movie intervals, alternatives, distortions, missingness and provenance.

Terminal court: a fixed admitted pair runs twice byte-identically; raw video is absent from the Git tree and output artifact; posterior rows and flow marginals pass their checked contracts; every displayed mass is accounted for; exact interval and receipt links resolve. Mutations for omission, compression or split-merge, backward revisit, reorder, external excursion, distorted facet, missing support, foreign edition, foreign receipt and non-finite measurement each fail or change only the predeclared observable.

Shortest governed path:
G0. Reducer landability: owner or admin resolves stranded cand-1EE04BNN2PY3AKNAFP32YK42YD. No current-main candidate is authorized while ancestor_blocked remains.

It fixes policy only; a follow-on artifact-binding receipt must establish media, annotation, recall, alias and timebase identities without video bytes.
C1. After P1 and B0 realization, portable source contracts land in core only: one new source contract file, atlas conformance, construction probes and core laws. No decoder, provider or JVM type.

D1. Then migrate the exact compiler, story envelope, alignment source projection and codecs needed for heterogeneous EvidenceSupport while preserving all text behavior.

Parallel prerequisites that may finish their current immutable handoff but may not claim the product: output authority repair, P/F visualization court, nomination provenance court and external-floor calibration court. Implementation of calibration, generalized exporters, docs-site styling and unrelated audits is subordinate until the vertical reaches E0.
